jurisdiction_boundary.governance_level: country within the United Kingdom for the cited education sources
includes: England maintained schools, academies, non-association independent schools, and relevant post-16 settings where the cited Ofsted/DfE sources apply.
jurisdiction_boundary.boundary_warning: England is not the whole United Kingdom; DfE subject content is not an exam-board approval route.

authority_type.inspection_or_school_evaluation: covered_for_descriptor: Ofsted education inspection framework and school operating guidance.
authority_type.curriculum: covered_for_descriptor: DfE GCE AS and A level economics subject content.
authority_type.examination: covered_as_qualification_content_only: no exam-board specification, paper, mark scheme, or awarding-body approval is included.
authority_type.accountability: covered_for_school_owned_boundary: Ofsted material informs inspection/accountability vocabulary but not product authority.
authority_type.accreditation: not_covered_in_descriptor: no accreditation source is used.
authority_type.regional_or_state_overlay: not_applicable_to_descriptor: England-only boundary; other UK systems require separate descriptors.

official_source_allowlist.title: Education inspection framework: for use from November 2025
official_source_allowlist.authority_strength: official source for the bounded jurisdiction role named here
official_source_allowlist.allowed_use: Name England inspection evaluation areas, inclusion/safeguarding vocabulary, and school-owned evidence boundaries.
official_source_allowlist.forbidden_inference: Does not approve 4veco, represent the whole UK, or make a textbook inspection-ready.

official_source_allowlist.title: GCE AS and A level subject content for economics
official_source_allowlist.authority_strength: official source for the bounded jurisdiction role named here
official_source_allowlist.allowed_use: Map upper-secondary economics concepts and assessment-objective language at subject-content level.
official_source_allowlist.forbidden_inference: Does not make a 4veco book an approved A level specification, exam-board resource, or summative assessment.

official_source_allowlist.title: [Currently in use] School inspection operating guide for inspectors
official_source_allowlist.authority_strength: official source for the bounded jurisdiction role named here
official_source_allowlist.allowed_use: Keep school-owned inspection evidence separate from product evidence.
official_source_allowlist.forbidden_inference: Does not authorize automated evidence-pack generation or school-facing inspection claims.

source_freshness.refresh_required_before: Any England-specific country edition, teacher/school-facing output, exam-board mapping, inspection claim, or public claim.

curriculum_mappings.local_authority_anchor: DfE economics subject content; exam-board specifications remain out of scope.
curriculum_mappings.overlay_action: Translate Dutch terms to English economics vocabulary and later map to exact DfE/A level topic and assessment-objective language.

curriculum_mappings.local_authority_anchor: DfE economics subject content; Ofsted is inspection vocabulary only.
curriculum_mappings.overlay_action: Separate reusable market-mechanism pedagogy from local exam-board question forms.

assessment_mappings.allowed_internal_use: Record that DfE subject content can guide concept-level mapping only.
assessment_mappings.forbidden_inference: No A level exam-board specification, mark scheme, grade boundary, or awarding-body approval is included.

institution_example_substitutions: Use England-specific institutions only after review; do not convert them into UK-wide examples.
Currency and policy examples require pound sterling and English policy context where used.
Exam examples require a separately sourced awarding-body overlay before any student-facing use.
accessibility_inclusion_terminology: learners who face barriers to learning and/or wellbeing
school_owned_evidence_boundary: Ofsted evidence gathering, leadership, safeguarding, attendance, support, and implementation evidence belongs to the school and inspectorate process.
Product evidence can support curriculum reasoning only; it cannot supply inspection evidence by itself.
forbidden_claims: The descriptor authorizes a teacher/school-facing England edition.
DfE subject content equals exam-board approval.
proof_required_to_close: England source refresh by a country/source reviewer.
Exam-board-specific source allowlist if assessment mapping is ever authorised.
Teacher/economics review of all terminology substitutions.
Human approval before any local edition or public/school-facing output.

finding_classification.finding: England descriptor has an explicit jurisdiction boundary and official source allowlist.
finding_classification.does_not_block: Proceeding to human review for the architecture packet.
finding_classification.proof_required_to_close: Country/source reviewer PASS and checker PASS.

finding_classification.finding: England retains local assessment and school-owned evidence gaps.
finding_classification.blocks: Country edition, public/school-facing output, assessment-readiness, inspection/accreditation, and compliance claims.
finding_classification.proof_required_to_close: Separate authorised source refresh and human gate before any local implementation.

finding_classification.finding: England forbids downstream product and authority jumps.
finding_classification.blocks: Product-route adoption, Scale Gate, diagnostics/mastery/PV, student/product use, personal-data processing, OP0, PTA, summative, and inspection-readiness claims.
finding_classification.does_not_block: Manual internal analytical review of the descriptor.
finding_classification.proof_required_to_close: Future explicit human authorisation with local expert/legal review.
